cards.name: 薄膜晨光
cards.brief: A translucent blue overshirt hangs past an opaque tank and wide shorts. Backlight reveals seams rather than turning the body luminous. Coral is concentrated in a small accessory, letting the layered construction carry the futuristic idea.
cards.hair: 侧分齐下巴短直发＋珊瑚发夹

cards.name: 模块穿行
cards.brief: A short pocket vest organises the upper body above tapered cargo trousers. Pale grey separates the graphite layers, while yellow marks a limited number of functional points. Every visible strap must connect to something.

cards.name: 数字汽水
cards.brief: A rounded violet jacket sits above one diagonal skirt panel. Chartreuse rib knit creates a bright central plane. The future feels playful and compact, with glossy details confined to small areas rather than every surface.

cards.name: 精确的早晨
cards.brief: The long navy coat and high-waisted trousers form a continuous line. A cropped oat-coloured knit keeps the waist readable. Tomato-red flats are the single sharp interruption in an otherwise quiet material study.

cards.name: 雨前大格纹
cards.brief: Large green checks establish a broad upper volume above a pink cotton skirt. Brown-black shoes anchor the pale lower half. Soft daylight should preserve the rough coat surface instead of smoothing all the fabrics together.

cards.name: 活动的褶线
cards.brief: A short steel-blue jacket leaves room for the drawstring skirt to expand below it. Pale yellow rib knit brightens the centre. A step on the stairs makes the skirt’s adjustable volume visible.

cards.name: 借阅期限
cards.brief: A roomy checked blazer and wide trousers make reading clothes that permit movement. The ink-blue turtleneck stays visually quiet. A note at the borrowing desk gives the pockets and satchel an actual purpose.

cards.name: 共用书桌
cards.brief: A short moss-green knit jacket ends above a box-pleated skirt. The full cotton sleeves remain distinct from the heavier knit. Passing a notebook across a shared desk reveals how the cuffs and waist behave.

cards.name: 夜课归途
cards.brief: A straight ink-blue shirt dress is lengthened by a grey-violet cardigan. Mustard appears in a narrow scarf. Waiting for a bus after class replaces the familiar fantasy of an empty private library.

cards.name: 翅翼的空气
cards.brief: A light blouse and three unequal skirt layers describe air rather than a literal pair of wings. Sparse embroidery follows branching lines. The pale colours stay distinct under side light, and the separate camisole remains a real layer.

cards.name: 腐叶与铜
cards.brief: A short rounded cape and long trousers place the strongest volume above a narrow waist area. Bark, copper and moss suggest a forest floor in change. The small seed-like brooch carries the only metallic accent.

cards.name: 暮色地衣
cards.brief: An asymmetric knitted dress meets a long transparent layer. Violet, lichen yellow and smoke grey build a colder forest mood. Turning beside a stone wall reveals differences in opacity without adding another flower crown.
cards.hair: 扭结低盘髻＋单支叶脉发簪

cards.name: 热身之后
cards.brief: A pink wrap cardigan crosses above high-waisted straight trousers. The side tie changes the upper silhouette as it loosens. Berry-coloured flats and a quiet base tank keep the outfit grounded in ordinary dressing.
cards.hair: 光洁芭蕾高髻＋窄针织发带

cards.name: 长褶呼吸
cards.brief: A compact ribbed top gives the long pleated skirt room to move. Smoke blue and chalk-white carry the main surfaces. The narrow wrap and small earrings avoid competing with the rhythm of the skirt.
cards.hair: 齐耳直短发＋利落短刘海

cards.name: 休息间隙
cards.brief: A long ribbed dress sits beneath a fine short-sleeved layer. Pale yellow, cocoa and plum replace a compulsory pink palette. Rolling up an outer garment gives rest and preparation a place inside the card.
cards.hair: 顺直低马尾＋李紫细发圈

cards.name: 结的用途
cards.brief: The narrow tie closes a crisp pale-blue shirt above a dark straight skirt. Cherry shoes punctuate the lower edge. Ornament has a visible task, and the wearer adjusts it herself rather than simply displaying it.
cards.hair: 及肩直发、两侧收于耳后

cards.name: 严肃的粉色
cards.brief: A dusty-pink waistcoat and wide trousers build a serious tailored shape. Soft sleeve ties complicate that structure without covering it. The bow becomes a small point of negotiation between firmness and volume.

cards.name: 格纹的偏心
cards.brief: An A-line checked dress uses a side tie to gather real cloth. Untying it releases the silhouette. Berry, cream and green make the outfit lively without requiring every accessory to repeat a ribbon.
cards.hair: 半扎顺直长发＋单个莓红发结

cards.name: 靛蓝行走
cards.brief: A short embroidered blouse meets a long panelled skirt. Indigo carries the broad surface, while clay-coloured shoes remain quiet. The embroidery is described by its stitches and location, without an invented cultural origin.

cards.name: 藏红花与粉笔
cards.brief: A saffron suede jacket ends above chalk-coloured wide trousers. The full cotton sleeves are visible at the cuffs. No fringe is required: short against long and soft nap against dry cloth already provide contrast.
cards.hair: 蓬松但轮廓整洁的短卷发

cards.name: 长风里的空隙
cards.brief: A loose clay-coloured dress moves beneath a cropped openwork vest. Its broad hem is not cut into leaves or covered in symbols. The card studies cloth in wind, with craft detail kept specific and localised.
cards.hair: 两股低长辫、无发饰堆叠

cards.name: 采购午餐
cards.brief: A tomato-red square-neck dress is softened by a short cream shirt. Olive sandals leave the skirt as the largest colour plane. Putting groceries into a basket makes the holiday image part of ordinary work.

cards.name: 车窗与海蓝
cards.brief: A long sea-blue shirt crosses above wide pale shorts. A small lemon scarf marks the upper edge. Waiting on a platform, the wearer carries a light bag rather than posing against an invented luxury holiday.
cards.hair: 耳下短卷发、细丝巾作发带

cards.name: 饭后步行
cards.brief: A soft coral knit rests above a long brown linen skirt. A pale-green layer can be added as the evening cools. The whole outfit relies on fibre and drape rather than a conspicuous resort print.

cards.name: 转角的条纹
cards.brief: A boxy navy jacket frames alternating stripes above cropped trousers. Red shoes add a clear end point. Walking around a street corner changes the stripes from a flat graphic into a moving surface.

cards.name: 不是制服
cards.brief: A loose pale-blue shirt and high-waisted work trousers describe a character with things to do. Mustard appears in a document bag. The cuffs, pockets and step matter more than a claim of national taste.
cards.hair: 高束直马尾＋简洁金属发夹

cards.name: 一件红外套
cards.brief: A brick-red coat interrupts a dark straight dress. The outfit forms one clear colour plane within an ordinary street. Turning to read a sign gives the image a cinematic action rather than a borrowed film costume.
cards.hair: 下颌不对称短发＋窄框眼镜
